title: PTSD treatments

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
PTSD treatments are defined as any system of behavioral principles which provide long-term assistance for functional behavior from relatively few entactogen cognition episodes. These therapies encompass both dissuading dysfunctional behavior and encouraging functional behavior.

This page lists and describes the various PTSD treatments.

See also

*Tripsitting index
*Subjective effect index
*Entactogens
